question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "magnanimous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Selfish.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Magnanimous" means generous and noble-hearted, especially in forgiving others. (उदार और दरियादिल)
◦ Example: The winning captain was magnanimous in victory, praising his rivals' effort.

 

• "Selfish" means concerned only with one's own interests, without regard for others, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वार्थी)
◦ Example: His selfish behaviour left no room for compromise.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Generous (उदार): Means willing to give freely — a synonym of magnanimous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Benevolent (परोपकारी): Means kind and charitable in nature — a synonym of magnanimous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Charitable (दानशील): Means generous in giving to those in need — a synonym of magnanimous, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• The related noun is magnanimity (उदारता), meaning generosity of spirit in forgiving or giving.

 

• Synonyms of magnanimous: generous, benevolent, charitable, noble, big-hearted.

 

• Synonyms of selfish: self-centred, egotistic, self-serving, greedy, mean.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sporadic (अनियमित): Frequent (बार-बार), Regular (नियमित)

2. Meticulous (सावधानीपूर्वक): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (अस्तव्यस्त)

3. Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Concise (संक्षिप्त), Terse (रूखा और संक्षिप्त)

4. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

5. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Deceptive (छलपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Tenacious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Yielding.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Tenacious" means holding firmly to something and not giving up easily. (दृढ़ और हठी)

 

• "Yielding" means giving way easily under pressure, and figuratively lacking firm resolve. It is therefore the correct antonym. (नरम और झुकने वाला)
◦ Example: Unlike his tenacious brother, he was yielding and gave up at the first sign of resistance.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Persistent (लगातार प्रयासरत) — continuing firmly in a course of action; a synonym of tenacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Stubborn (जिद्दी) — refusing to change one's mind or course; a synonym of tenacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Resolute (दृढ़संकल्प) — firm and determined; a synonym of tenacious, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of tenacious: flexible, weak, irresolute, submissive, wavering.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर): Permanent (स्थायी), Enduring (चिरस्थायी)

2. Benevolent (परोपकारी): Malevolent (दुर्भावनापूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

3. Timid (डरपोक): Bold (साहसी), Brave (बहादुर)

4. Genuine (वास्तविक): Fake (नकली), Counterfeit (जाली)

5. Diligent (परिश्रमी): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निष्क्रिय)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "blistering".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Chilly.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Blistering" means extremely hot, scorching in intensity. (तेज़ और झुलसाने वाला)
◦ Example: The runners struggled in the blistering heat of the afternoon sun.

 

• "Chilly" means unpleasantly cold, and is therefore the correct antonym. (ठंडा या सर्द)
◦ Example: A chilly wind blew across the valley that evening.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Scorching (झुलसाने वाला): Means intensely hot enough to burn — a synonym of blistering, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Searing (जलाने वाला): Means burning hot or intense — a synonym of blistering, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Sweltering (उमस भरा गर्म): Means uncomfortably hot and humid — a synonym of blistering, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of blistering: scorching, searing, sweltering, torrid, fierce.

 

• Synonyms of chilly: cold, cool, frosty, wintry, nippy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Optimistic (आशावादी): Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Despondent (हताश)

2. Voluntary (स्वैच्छिक): Compulsory (अनिवार्य), Forced (जबरन)

3. Ancient (प्राचीन): Modern (आधुनिक), Contemporary (समकालीन)

4. Abundant (प्रचुर): Scarce (दुर्लभ), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त)

5. Cautious (सतर्क): Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (उतावला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Eager."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Indifferent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Eager" means having keen interest or strong desire to do something. (उत्सुक)

 

• "Indifferent" means having no particular interest or concern, and figuratively showing no enthusiasm at all. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उदासीन)
◦ Example: He remained indifferent to the news that excited everyone else in the room.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Enthusiastic (उत्साही) — full of energetic interest; a synonym of eager, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Keen (इच्छुक) — having sharp interest or desire; a synonym of eager, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Avid (अत्यंत उत्सुक) — having an intense enthusiasm for something; a synonym of eager, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of eager: reluctant, apathetic, unenthusiastic, listless, uninterested.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (अहंकारी), Proud (घमंडी)

2. Transparent (पारदर्शी): Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Obscure (अस्पष्ट)

3. Vague (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक)

4. Reluctant (अनिच्छुक): Willing (इच्छुक), Eager (उत्सुक)

5. Trivial (तुच्छ): Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Crucial (निर्णायक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "recount".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Suppress.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Recount" means to narrate or tell the details of an event. (विस्तार से बताना या वर्णन करना)
◦ Example: She recounted her journey through the mountains to the eager listeners.

 

• "Suppress" means to withhold or keep something from being told or known, and is therefore the correct antonym. (दबाना या छिपाना)
◦ Example: The officials tried to suppress the details of the incident.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Narrate (वर्णन करना): Means to tell a story or give a spoken account — a synonym of recount, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Describe (चित्रण करना): Means to give a detailed account of something — a synonym of recount, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Relate (सुनाना): Means to give an account of events — a synonym of recount, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of recount: narrate, describe, relate, recite, detail.

 

• Synonyms of suppress: withhold, conceal, stifle, repress, quash.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Fragile (नाजुक): Sturdy (मजबूत), Robust (हृष्ट-पुष्ट)

2. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रवत), Amicable (सौहार्दपूर्ण)

3. Ambiguous (द्विअर्थी): Explicit (स्पष्ट रूप से कहा गया), Definite (निश्चित)

4. Static (स्थिर): Dynamic (गतिशील), Changing (परिवर्तनशील)

5. Rigid (कठोर): Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नमनीय)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Lucid."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Confusing.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Lucid" means expressed clearly and easily understood. (स्पष्ट और सुबोध)

 

• "Confusing" means difficult to understand or follow, and figuratively muddled in expression. It is therefore the correct antonym. (भ्रामक या उलझाने वाला)
◦ Example: His confusing explanation left the students more puzzled than before.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Clear (स्पष्ट) — easy to perceive or understand; a synonym of lucid, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Coherent (सुसंगत) — logical and consistent, easy to follow; a synonym of lucid, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Transparent (पारदर्शी) — easy to see through or understand; a synonym of lucid, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of lucid: vague, obscure, unclear, murky, ambiguous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Worldly (व्यवहारकुशल)

2. Concise (संक्षिप्त): Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण), Lengthy (लंबा)

3. Miser (कंजूस): Generous (उदार), Lavish (फिजूलखर्च करने वाला)

4. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Lethargic (सुस्त)

5. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Imprudent (अविवेकी), Reckless (लापरवाह)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "impervious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Permeable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Impervious" means not able to be penetrated or affected by something. (अभेद्य या अप्रभावित रहने वाला)
◦ Example: The coating made the fabric impervious to water.

 

• "Permeable" means allowing liquids or gases to pass through, and is therefore the correct antonym. (भेद्य या पारगम्य)
◦ Example: Sand is a permeable material that lets water seep through easily.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Impenetrable (अभेद्य): Means unable to be passed through — a synonym of impervious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Resistant (प्रतिरोधी): Means able to withstand the effect of something — a synonym of impervious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Unaffected (अप्रभावित): Means not influenced or changed by something — a synonym of impervious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of impervious: impenetrable, resistant, unaffected, immune, insusceptible.

 

• Synonyms of permeable: porous, penetrable, pervious, absorbent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Amiable (मिलनसार): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमित्र)

2. Coarse (खुरदरा): Smooth (चिकना), Fine (महीन)

3. Brittle (भंगुर): Flexible (लचीला), Tough (मजबूत)

4. Diminish (घटाना): Increase (बढ़ाना), Augment (बढ़ाना)

5. Compassionate (दयालु): Callous (निष्ठुर), Cruel (क्रूर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Mythical."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Verifiable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Mythical" means existing only in myth or legend; not real or factual. (पौराणिक या काल्पनिक)

 

• "Verifiable" means capable of being proven true through evidence, and figuratively grounded in fact rather than legend. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सत्यापन योग्य या प्रामाणिक)
◦ Example: Unlike mythical tales, the scientist's claims were verifiable through experiments.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Fictional (कल्पित) — invented and not based on real events; a synonym of mythical, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Legendary (पौराणिक) — described in legends rather than history; a synonym of mythical, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Imaginary (काल्पनिक) — existing only in the imagination; a synonym of mythical, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of mythical: real, factual, historical, actual, authentic.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Volatile (अस्थिर): Stable (स्थिर), Steady (स्थिर)

2. Feeble (कमज़ोर): Strong (मजबूत), Robust (हृष्ट-पुष्ट)

3. Lethargic (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय)

4. Meager (अल्प): Ample (पर्याप्त), Abundant (प्रचुर)

5. Placid (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Agitated (उत्तेजित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "falter".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Persist.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Falter" means to hesitate or lose strength and momentum while doing something. (लड़खड़ाना या हिचकिचाना)
◦ Example: Her voice faltered as she read out the tragic news.

 

• "Persist" means to continue firmly and steadily despite difficulty, and is therefore the correct antonym. (दृढ़ता से जारी रखना)
◦ Example: Despite repeated setbacks, she persisted with her research.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Waver (डगमगाना): Means to become unsteady or indecisive — a synonym of falter, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Hesitate (हिचकिचाना): Means to pause due to uncertainty — a synonym of falter, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Stumble (लड़खड़ाना): Means to trip or lose balance while acting — a synonym of falter, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of falter: waver, hesitate, stumble, wobble, flounder.

 

• Synonyms of persist: continue, persevere, endure, carry on.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Obscure (अस्पष्ट): Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Renowned (प्रख्यात)

2. Punctual (समयनिष्ठ): Late (देर से आने वाला), Tardy (विलंबकारी)

3. Sturdy (मजबूत): Fragile (नाजुक), Flimsy (कमज़ोर)

4. Terse (रूखा और संक्षिप्त): Wordy (वाचाल), Elaborate (विस्तृत)

5. Vivid (सजीव): Dull (फीका), Bland (नीरस)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Perturbed."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Calm.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Perturbed" means feeling anxious, unsettled, or worried about something. (परेशान या व्याकुल)

 

• "Calm" means free from agitation or disturbance, and figuratively composed and at ease. It is therefore the correct antonym. (शांत)
◦ Example: She remained calm even as the situation grew tense around her.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Agitated (उत्तेजित) — troubled or excited due to anxiety; a synonym of perturbed, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Anxious (चिंतित) — feeling worried or nervous; a synonym of perturbed, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Disturbed (व्याकुल) — upset or troubled in mind; a synonym of perturbed, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of perturbed: composed, unruffled, tranquil, serene, placid.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Wane (घटना): Wax (बढ़ना), Grow (बढ़ना)

2. Zenith (चरम बिंदु): Nadir (निम्नतम बिंदु), Bottom (तल)

3. Amateur (नौसिखिया): Professional (पेशेवर), Expert (विशेषज्ञ)

4. Blunt (कुंद या स्पष्टवादी): Sharp (तेज़), Tactful (चतुराईपूर्ण)

5. Chaotic (अव्यवस्थित): Orderly (व्यवस्थित), Systematic (क्रमबद्ध)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "docile".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Headstrong.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Docile" means easily managed or taught; obedient and gentle in nature. (आज्ञाकारी और विनम्र)
◦ Example: The docile horse followed every command without resistance.

 

• "Headstrong" means stubbornly determined to have one's own way, and is therefore the correct antonym. (हठी या जिद्दी)
◦ Example: The headstrong child refused to listen to any advice.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Obedient (आज्ञाकारी): Means readily complying with instructions — a synonym of docile, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Submissive (विनम्र): Means meekly yielding to authority — a synonym of docile, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Compliant (अनुपालक): Means inclined to agree with others or follow rules — a synonym of docile, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of docile: obedient, submissive, compliant, tractable, meek.

 

• Synonyms of headstrong: stubborn, obstinate, willful, self-willed.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Gullible (भोला): Skeptical (संशयवादी), Shrewd (चतुर)

2. Hasty (जल्दबाज़): Deliberate (सोच-समझकर किया गया), Cautious (सतर्क)

3. Impartial (निष्पक्ष): Biased (पक्षपाती), Prejudiced (पूर्वाग्रही)

4. Jubilant (हर्षित): Sorrowful (दुखी), Gloomy (उदास)

5. Kindle (प्रज्वलित करना): Extinguish (बुझाना), Smother (दबाना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ruthless."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Compassionate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Ruthless" means having no pity or compassion for others; merciless and cruel in dealing with people. (निर्दयी)

 

• "Compassionate" means feeling deep sympathy and concern for the suffering of others, and figuratively/practically someone who shows kindness and mercy in dealing with people. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दयालु)
◦ Example: The nurse was compassionate towards every patient in the ward, no matter how difficult their condition.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Merciless (निर्दयी) — showing no mercy at all; a synonym of ruthless, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Cruel (क्रूर) — willfully causing pain or suffering; a synonym of ruthless, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Pitiless (निष्ठुर) — feeling or showing no pity; a synonym of ruthless, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of ruthless: kind, merciful, gentle, humane, benevolent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Diligent (मेहनती): Lazy (आलसी), Indolent (सुस्त)

2. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (अस्तव्यस्त)

3. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फ़िज़ूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

4. Genuine (असली): Fake (नकली), Counterfeit (जाली)

5. Ample (प्रचुर): Insufficient (अपर्याप्त), Scanty (अल्प)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "barbarous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Civilized.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Barbarous" means extremely cruel, brutal, and uncivilized in behaviour. (बर्बर)
◦ Example: The invading army committed barbarous acts against the defenceless villagers.

 

• "Civilized" means having a well-developed, culturally refined and orderly society or manner of behaviour, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सभ्य)
◦ Example: A civilized society settles its disputes through law and dialogue, not violence.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Savage (जंगली): Fierce, violent, and uncontrolled — a synonym of barbarous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Brutal (निर्दय): Extremely cruel and violent — a synonym of barbarous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Cruel (क्रूर): Willfully causing pain or suffering — a synonym of barbarous, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of barbarous: savage, brutal, cruel, uncivilized, ferocious, inhuman.

 

• Synonyms of civilized: cultured, refined, enlightened, polished, sophisticated.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Deceptive (छलपूर्ण), Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला)

2. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Unruly (उद्दंड), Rebellious (विद्रोही)

3. Eloquent (वाक्पटु): Inarticulate (अस्पष्टवक्ता), Stammering (हकलाने वाला)

4. Feeble (कमजोर): Strong (मजबूत), Vigorous (ओजस्वी)

5. Gaudy (भड़कीला): Elegant (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Refined (परिष्कृत)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Infernal."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Heavenly.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Infernal" means relating to hell, or extremely troublesome and unpleasant. (नारकीय)

 

• "Heavenly" means relating to heaven; extremely pleasant, delightful, or divine, and figuratively/practically something that brings peace and joy rather than torment. It is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वर्गीय)
◦ Example: After the long trek, the cool mountain breeze felt heavenly.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Hellish (नारकीय) — resembling hell in being extremely unpleasant; a synonym of infernal, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Diabolical (शैतानी) — showing the cunning or cruelty of the devil; a synonym of infernal, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Devilish (पैशाचिक) — characteristic of or resembling a devil; a synonym of infernal, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of infernal: heavenly, divine, angelic, pleasant, delightful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रवत), Amicable (सौहार्दपूर्ण)

2. Impartial (निष्पक्ष): Biased (पक्षपाती), Prejudiced (पूर्वाग्रही)

3. Jovial (खुशमिजाज): Gloomy (उदास), Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा)

4. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Confusing (भ्रामक), Muddled (गड्डमड्ड)

5. Malign (बदनाम करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Commend (सराहना करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "bold".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Timid.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Bold" means showing courage, confidence, and a willingness to take risks. (साहसी)
◦ Example: It was a bold decision to launch the new product during a slowdown, but it paid off.

 

• "Timid" means showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened, and is therefore the correct antonym. (डरपोक)
◦ Example: The timid puppy hid under the bed whenever a stranger entered the house.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Courageous (साहसी): Not afraid to face danger or pain — a synonym of bold, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Daring (दुस्साहसी): Willing to take risks; adventurous — a synonym of bold, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Fearless (निडर): Feeling or showing no fear — a synonym of bold, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of bold: courageous, daring, fearless, brave, audacious, confident.

 

• Synonyms of timid: shy, fearful, meek, nervous, apprehensive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Worldly (सांसारिक अनुभव वाला)

2. Opulent (समृद्ध): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (दरिद्र)

3. Pristine (अछूता): Filthy (गंदा), Contaminated (दूषित)

4. Quaint (पुराने ढंग का): Modern (आधुनिक), Ordinary (साधारण)

5. Robust (हृष्ट-पुष्ट): Weak (कमज़ोर), Frail (दुर्बल)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Obscure."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Prominent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Obscure" means not discovered, known, or clearly expressed; not well known to the public. (अस्पष्ट)

 

• "Prominent" means important, well known, or standing out so as to be easily noticed, and figuratively/practically someone or something that draws attention rather than staying hidden. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रमुख)
◦ Example: She is a prominent scientist whose work is discussed in every major journal.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Unclear (अस्पष्ट) — not easy to see, hear, or understand; a synonym of obscure, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Vague (धुंधला) — of uncertain, indefinite, or unclear character; a synonym of obscure, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Unknown (अज्ञात) — not known or familiar; a synonym of obscure, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of obscure: prominent, famous, well-known, clear, evident, distinguished.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Serene (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Chaotic (अराजक)

2. Tedious (उबाऊ): Interesting (रोचक), Exciting (रोमांचक)

3. Uniform (एकसमान): Varied (विविध), Diverse (विभिन्न)

4. Vivid (जीवंत): Dull (फीका), Faded (धुंधला)

5. Wary (सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "axiom".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Absurdity.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Axiom" means a statement or principle that is widely accepted as true without needing proof. (स्वयंसिद्ध सिद्धांत)
◦ Example: "Honesty is the best policy" is treated almost as an axiom in ethical teaching.

 

• "Absurdity" means something that is wildly unreasonable, illogical, or ridiculous, the opposite of a self-evident truth, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बेतुकापन)
◦ Example: The claim that the earth is flat is now regarded as an absurdity by scientists.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Truth (सत्य): A fact or belief that is verifiably correct — a synonym of axiom, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Principle (सिद्धांत): A fundamental truth or proposition serving as a foundation for a system of belief — a synonym of axiom, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Maxim (सूक्ति): A short, generally accepted statement of a general truth — a synonym of axiom, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of axiom: truth, principle, maxim, postulate, fundamental, self-evident truth.

 

• Synonyms of absurdity: nonsense, foolishness, irrationality, ridiculousness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (निर्लिप्त)

2. Benevolent (परोपकारी): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Malicious (दुर्भावनापूर्ण)

3. Concise (संक्षिप्त): Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण), Lengthy (लंबा)

4. Elated (अत्यंत प्रसन्न): Depressed (उदास), Dejected (निराश)

5. Frank (स्पष्टवादी): Secretive (गोपनीय), Reserved (संकोची)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Morbid."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Cheerful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Morbid" means having or showing an unhealthy interest in death, disease, or other disturbing subjects; gloomy. (रुग्ण)

 

• "Cheerful" means noticeably happy and optimistic, and figuratively/practically someone whose outlook is bright rather than dwelling on gloomy or disturbing thoughts. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रसन्न)
◦ Example: Despite the rain, she remained cheerful throughout the journey.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Gloomy (उदास) — feeling or showing sadness or depression; a synonym in mood of morbid, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Unhealthy (अस्वस्थ) — not conducive to good health, especially in interest or mindset; a synonym of morbid in this sense, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Ghastly (भयानक) — causing great horror or fear; closely related to the disturbing sense of morbid, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of morbid: cheerful, healthy, wholesome, happy, pleasant.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Gullible (भोला): Skeptical (संशयवादी), Suspicious (शंकालु)

2. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी)

3. Immense (विशाल): Tiny (छोटा), Minuscule (अत्यंत छोटा)

4. Jubilant (उल्लासित): Sad (दुखी), Sorrowful (शोकाकुल)

5. Keen (उत्सुक): Indifferent (उदासीन), Uninterested (अनुत्सुक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "reverence".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Disrespect.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Reverence" means deep respect and admiration for someone or something, often tinged with awe. (श्रद्धा)
◦ Example: The students bowed with reverence before their teacher on Guru Purnima.

 

• "Disrespect" means a lack of respect or courtesy; contempt shown towards someone or something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अनादर)
◦ Example: Shouting at the elderly guest was seen as a clear act of disrespect.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Veneration (आदर): Great respect, especially for something sacred or revered — a synonym of reverence, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Respect (सम्मान): Deep admiration for someone based on their qualities or achievements — a synonym of reverence, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Admiration (प्रशंसा): A feeling of respect and warm approval — a synonym of reverence, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of reverence: veneration, respect, awe, admiration, homage.

 

• Synonyms of disrespect: contempt, insolence, disdain, rudeness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Lavish (भव्य): Sparse (अल्प), Meagre (कम)

2. Meek (नम्र): Aggressive (आक्रामक), Assertive (दृढ़तापूर्वक अपनी बात रखने वाला)

3. Notorious (कुख्यात): Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित), Honorable (सम्माननीय)

4. Optimistic (आशावादी): Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Cynical (संशयवादी)

5. Placid (शांत): Agitated (उत्तेजित), Volatile (अस्थिर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Glut."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Starve.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Glut" means an excessive or oversized supply of something, or to fill something to excess. (अत्यधिक आपूर्ति)

 

• "Starve" means to suffer or die from lack of food, or to deprive of something needed, and figuratively/practically the state of severe shortage rather than excess supply. It is therefore the correct antonym. (भूखा रखना)
◦ Example: During the drought, the region's markets were starved of even basic grain supplies.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Oversupply (अधिक आपूर्ति) — an amount greater than what is needed; a synonym of glut, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Surfeit (अतिरेक) — an excessive amount of something; a synonym of glut, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Overfill (अत्यधिक भरना) — to fill something beyond its capacity; a synonym of glut, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of glut: shortage, scarcity, dearth, starve, deprive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Quiescent (निष्क्रिय): Active (सक्रिय), Restless (बेचैन)

2. Reticent (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Outspoken (स्पष्टवादी)

3. Solemn (गंभीर): Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Lighthearted (हल्के-फुल्के मिजाज़ का)

4. Trivial (तुच्छ): Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Crucial (अत्यावश्यक)

5. Unruly (उद्दंड): Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Disciplined (अनुशासित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "grisly".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Attractive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Grisly" means causing horror, disgust, or repulsion, especially through gruesome appearance. (भयानक)
◦ Example: Investigators arrived at the scene of a grisly murder in the abandoned warehouse.

 

• "Attractive" means pleasing or appealing to the eye or mind; charming, and is therefore the correct antonym. (आकर्षक)
◦ Example: The newly renovated garden looked attractive to every visitor.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Gruesome (भयावह): Causing repulsion or horror — a synonym of grisly, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Horrifying (भयानक): Causing feelings of horror or shock — a synonym of grisly, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Ghastly (डरावना): Frighteningly horrible or shocking — a synonym of grisly, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of grisly: gruesome, horrifying, ghastly, macabre, gory.

 

• Synonyms of attractive: pleasing, appealing, charming, alluring.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vigilant (सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Inattentive (असावधान)

2. Wane (क्षीण होना): Wax (चढ़ना), Increase (वृद्धि होना)

3. Yield (झुक जाना): Resist (विरोध करना), Withstand (सामना करना)

4. Abate (कम होना): Intensify (तीव्र होना), Increase (बढ़ना)

5. Buoyant (उत्साही): Depressed (उदास), Downcast (निराश)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Harass."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Comfort.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Harass" means to subject someone to persistent aggressive pressure, intimidation, or annoyance. (परेशान करना)

 

• "Comfort" means to soothe or ease someone's grief, distress, or pain, and figuratively/practically to bring relief and peace instead of persistent trouble. It is therefore the correct antonym. (आराम देना)
◦ Example: She comforted the crying child until he calmed down.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Torment (सताना) — to cause severe physical or mental suffering; a synonym of harass, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Annoy (चिढ़ाना) — to make someone slightly angry through persistent behaviour; a synonym of harass, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Trouble (परेशान करना) — to cause difficulty or worry to someone; a synonym of harass, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of harass: comfort, console, soothe, assist, help.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Coy (शर्मीला): Forward (ढीठ), Brazen (निर्लज्ज)

2. Deft (निपुण): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Awkward (भद्दा)

3. Ebullient (उत्साह से भरपूर): Despondent (हताश), Melancholy (उदास)

4. Ardent (उत्कट): Cool (उदासीन), Unenthusiastic (अनुत्साही)

5. Blunt (रूखा): Tactful (चतुराईपूर्ण), Diplomatic (कूटनीतिक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "jovial".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Morose.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Jovial" means cheerful, good-humoured, and full of high spirits. (हंसमुख)
◦ Example: The jovial host greeted every guest with a warm laugh.

 

• "Morose" means gloomy, sullen, and ill-tempered, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उदास)
◦ Example: After losing the match, he sat in a morose silence for hours.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Cheerful (प्रफुल्लित): Bright and happy in mood — a synonym of jovial, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Genial (मिलनसार): Friendly and warm-hearted — a synonym of jovial, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Jolly (खुशमिजाज़): Full of good humour and fun — a synonym of jovial, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of jovial: cheerful, genial, jolly, merry, convivial, mirthful.

 

• Synonyms of morose: sullen, gloomy, sulky, glum, sombre.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म): Careless (लापरवाह), Negligent (उपेक्षापूर्ण)

2. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Secretive (गोपनीय), Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला)

3. Lethargic (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय)

4. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (अविवेकी), Rash (उतावला)

5. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Barren."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Fertile.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Barren" means unproductive, infertile, and unable to support plant or animal life. (बंजर)

 

• "Fertile" means rich and productive, capable of yielding abundant crops or vegetation, and figuratively fruitful in ideas as well. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उपजाऊ)
◦ Example: After irrigation, the once-barren land became fertile enough for three crops a year.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Arid (शुष्क) — extremely dry with little rainfall; a synonym of barren in the sense of unproductive land.

 

• Option 2: Desolate (वीरान) — empty, bleak, and devoid of life; close in sense to barren, not its opposite.

 

• Option 3: Sterile (निष्फल) — incapable of producing offspring or growth; a synonym of barren, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of barren: fruitful, fecund, productive, abundant, lush.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Diligent (मेहनती): Lazy (आलसी), Negligent (उपेक्षापूर्ण)

2. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

3. Amiable (मिलनसार): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमित्र)

4. Volatile (अस्थिर): Stable (स्थिर), Calm (शांत)

5. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Worldly (दुनियादार)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "insipid".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Appetizing.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Insipid" means lacking flavour or interest; dull and unexciting. (नीरस)
◦ Example: The critics called the sequel an insipid rehash of the original film.

 

• "Appetizing" means appealing to the taste, tempting, and full of flavour, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वादिष्ट)
◦ Example: The aroma of the appetizing curry filled the entire kitchen.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Bland (फीका): Lacking strong flavour or excitement — a synonym of insipid, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Dull (नीरस): Lacking interest or liveliness — a synonym of insipid, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Tasteless (बेस्वाद): Having no flavour at all — a synonym of insipid, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of insipid: bland, dull, tasteless, flat, vapid.

 

• Synonyms of appetizing: tasty, delicious, appealing, savoury, mouth-watering.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर): Permanent (स्थायी), Eternal (शाश्वत)

2. Benevolent (परोपकारी): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

3. Austere (सादा): Lavish (भव्य), Ornate (अलंकृत)

4. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Reserved (संकोची), Introverted (अंतर्मुखी)

5. Placate (शांत करना): Provoke (उकसाना), Enrage (क्रोधित करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Epitome."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Increase.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Epitome" means a summary or condensed account of something; a brief representation that captures its essential points. (सार-संक्षेप)

 

• "Increase" means growth or expansion in size, extent, or amount, the opposite of condensing something into a summary. It is therefore the correct antonym. (वृद्धि)
◦ Example: Far from an epitome, the revised report saw a sharp increase in length and detail.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Abstract (सार) — a condensed summary of a text; a synonym of epitome in this sense, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Digest (सारांश) — a short, condensed version of a longer work; a synonym of epitome, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Précis (संक्षेप) — a concise summary of the essential points; a synonym of epitome, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of epitome: expansion, amplification, elaboration, enlargement.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Meager (अपर्याप्त): Abundant (प्रचुर), Ample (पर्याप्त)

2. Laconic (संक्षिप्त): Verbose (वाचाल), Talkative (बातूनी)

3. Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक): Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक)

4. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (निर्लिप्त)

5. Wane (घटना): Wax (बढ़ना), Grow (विकसित होना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "malice".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Kindness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Malice" means a deep-seated desire to harm others; ill will or spite. (द्वेष)
◦ Example: He bore no malice towards the colleague who had once betrayed him.

 

• "Kindness" means the quality of being warm-hearted, generous, and considerate towards others, and is therefore the correct antonym. (दयालुता)
◦ Example: Her kindness to strangers made her beloved in the entire neighbourhood.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Spite (द्वेष): A petty desire to hurt or annoy someone — a synonym of malice, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Malevolence (दुर्भावना): The wish to do evil or cause harm to others — a synonym of malice, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Rancor (कटुता): Bitter, long-lasting resentment — a synonym of malice, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of malice: spite, malevolence, rancour, animosity, ill will.

 

• Synonyms of kindness: compassion, generosity, benevolence, warmth, goodwill.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Astute (चतुर): Naive (भोला), Foolish (मूर्ख)

2. Frivolous (तुच्छ): Serious (गंभीर), Sensible (समझदार)

3. Obdurate (हठी): Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Yielding (नम्र)

4. Vindicate (निर्दोष सिद्ध करना): Accuse (दोष लगाना), Condemn (निंदा करना)

5. Turbulent (अशांत): Calm (शांत), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Denounce."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Defend.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Denounce" means to publicly condemn or criticize someone or something strongly, often accusing them of wrongdoing. (निंदा करना)

 

• "Defend" means to support, justify, or protect someone or something against criticism or attack, and figuratively to stand up for its worth rather than condemn it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (बचाव करना)
◦ Example: The lawyer chose to defend her client rather than denounce his actions.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Condemn (निंदा करना) — to express strong disapproval of; a synonym of denounce, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Criticize (आलोचना करना) — to point out faults or express disapproval; a synonym of denounce, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Censure (भर्त्सना करना) — to formally express severe disapproval; a synonym of denounce, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of denounce: praise, commend, support, endorse, applaud.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Antagonistic (विरोधी)

2. Squander (फिजूलखर्ची करना): Save (बचाना), Conserve (संरक्षित करना)

3. Fortify (मजबूत करना): Weaken (कमजोर करना), Debilitate (दुर्बल करना)

4. Deride (उपहास करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Compliment (तारीफ़ करना)

5. Torpid (सुस्त): Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "taciturn".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Talkative.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Taciturn" means reserved or uncommunicative in speech; disinclined to talk. (अल्पभाषी)
◦ Example: The taciturn old farmer rarely spoke more than a few words a day.

 

• "Talkative" means fond of talking; tending to speak a great deal, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बातूनी)
◦ Example: Her talkative nature made her the life of every gathering.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Reserved (संकोची): Slow to reveal emotion or opinions — a synonym of taciturn, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Reticent (मितभाषी): Not revealing thoughts or feelings readily — a synonym of taciturn, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Silent (मौन): Making no sound; not speaking — a synonym of taciturn, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of taciturn: reserved, reticent, silent, uncommunicative, quiet.

 

• Synonyms of talkative: garrulous, chatty, loquacious, voluble, verbose.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Copious (प्रचुर): Scarce (दुर्लभ), Scanty (अल्प)

2. Belligerent (आक्रामक): Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Friendly (मित्रवत)

3. Rejuvenate (पुनर्जीवित करना): Exhaust (थका देना), Tire (थकाना)

4. Servile (दास-सुलभ): Domineering (हावी होने वाला), Assertive (दृढ़)

5. Ostentatious (दिखावटी): Modest (विनम्र), Understated (संयत)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Celebrated."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Inglorious.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Celebrated" means widely known and admired; famous for notable achievements. (प्रसिद्ध)

 

• "Inglorious" means shameful or dishonourable, lacking fame or glory, and figuratively marked by disgrace rather than celebrated achievement. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अपयशी)
◦ Example: The general's career ended not in triumph but in an inglorious defeat.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Renowned (विख्यात) — widely known and respected; a synonym of celebrated, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Illustrious (यशस्वी) — well known, respected, and admired for past achievements; a synonym of celebrated, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Eminent (प्रतिष्ठित) — famous and respected within a particular field; a synonym of celebrated, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of celebrated: unknown, obscure, unheralded, undistinguished.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Nefarious (दुष्ट): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Honorable (सम्मानित)

2. Placid (शांत): Agitated (उत्तेजित), Stormy (तूफानी)

3. Garrulous (बातूनी): Taciturn (अल्पभाषी), Quiet (मौन)

4. Indolent (आलसी): Diligent (मेहनती), Industrious (परिश्रमी)

5. Chastise (डांटना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Commend (सराहना करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "vivacious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Unattractive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Vivacious" means full of lively, attractive charm and high spirits. (जीवंत, आकर्षक)
◦ Example: Her vivacious personality made her the centre of attention at every party.

 

• "Unattractive" means lacking charm or appeal; not pleasing to look at or be around, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अनाकर्षक)
◦ Example: His dull, unattractive manner stood in sharp contrast to his vivacious sister.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Lively (सजीव): Full of energy and enthusiasm — a synonym of vivacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Animated (उत्साहित): Full of excitement and energetic movement — a synonym of vivacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Sprightly (फुर्तीला): Lively and full of energy, especially for one's age — a synonym of vivacious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of vivacious: lively, animated, sprightly, spirited, effervescent.

 

• Synonyms of unattractive: plain, unappealing, unsightly, homely, drab.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Pertinent (प्रासंगिक): Irrelevant (अप्रासंगिक), Unrelated (असंबंधित)

2. Languish (क्षीण होना): Thrive (फलना-फूलना), Flourish (समृद्ध होना)

3. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Unruly (उद्दंड), Defiant (विद्रोही)

4. Ravenous (अत्यंत भूखा): Satiated (तृप्त), Full (भरा हुआ)

5. Debase (घटिया बनाना): Elevate (ऊँचा उठाना), Enhance (बढ़ाना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Fallacy."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Truth.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Fallacy" means a mistaken belief or a flawed piece of reasoning that is based on unsound logic. (भ्रांति)

 

• "Truth" means that which is in accordance with fact or reality; a correct and verified belief, and figuratively the very opposite of a mistaken notion. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सत्य)
◦ Example: Scientific investigation eventually replaced the old fallacy with an established truth.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Misconception (गलतफहमी) — a view or opinion that is incorrect because based on faulty thinking; a synonym of fallacy, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Delusion (भ्रम) — a false belief held despite evidence to the contrary; a synonym of fallacy, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Error (त्रुटि) — a mistake or inaccuracy; a synonym of fallacy, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of fallacy: fact, reality, certainty, verity.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Adroit (निपुण): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Inept (अयोग्य)

2. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सतर्क), Deliberate (सोच-समझकर)

3. Solace (सांत्वना): Distress (पीड़ा), Torment (यातना)

4. Grievous (गंभीर): Trivial (तुच्छ), Minor (मामूली)

5. Bolster (मजबूत करना): Weaken (कमजोर करना), Undermine (क्षति पहुँचाना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "venerable".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Immature.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Venerable" means worthy of deep respect because of age, wisdom, or character. (आदरणीय)
◦ Example: The venerable old professor was consulted by scholars from across the country.

 

• "Immature" means not fully developed; lacking the wisdom, judgment, or dignity that comes with age and experience, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अपरिपक्व)
◦ Example: His immature behaviour at the meeting surprised everyone who knew his venerable reputation.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Respected (सम्मानित): Regarded with admiration and high esteem — a synonym of venerable, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Esteemed (प्रतिष्ठित): Held in great respect and admiration — a synonym of venerable, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Revered (श्रद्धेय): Regarded with deep and profound respect — a synonym of venerable, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of venerable: respected, esteemed, revered, honoured, distinguished.

 

• Synonyms of immature: childish, juvenile, unripe, undeveloped, inexperienced.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Prodigal (उड़ाऊ): Frugal (मितव्ययी), Thrifty (किफ़ायती)

2. Skeptical (संशयवादी): Credulous (भोला), Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला)

3. Ameliorate (सुधारना): Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Aggravate (बदतर बनाना)

4. Voracious (अत्यधिक भूखा): Moderate (संयमित), Abstemious (संयमी)

5. Impede (बाधा डालना): Facilitate (सुगम बनाना), Assist (सहायता करना)
